self_reflection_notes: Changes made: Raised authenticity_score from 2.5 to 3.0. Reasoning: Initial assessment was overly harsh on taxonomy deviations. The mushroom IS a valid Amanita muscaria with correct cap-and-stem morphology, visible gills, fleshy texture, and umbrella form - these satisfy core taxonomy checkpoints. The color mismatch (red vs white-brown-tan) is a species variation issue, not an artifact. Backpack rendering is actually quite good: bilateral symmetry, parallel straps, zippers, side pockets, grab handles, and synthetic fabric texture all pass their respective checkpoints. Only two genuine artifacts exist: text gibberish (severity 2) and stem grounding ambiguity (severity 3). Per checklist item 5 (Harshness Bias), multiple minor issues should compound but not dominate - the strong backpack rendering and valid mushroom morphology warrant a higher authenticity score than 2.5. Alignment score remains 2.0 as both spatial and counting failures are unambiguous. All atom scores verified independently against visual evidence and expert detectors - no rubber-stamping of Router verdicts occurred.
